text:
Leah: Thanks for a packed all-hands! Quick follow-ups from the comp/leveling section — trying to collect short answers so managers can update their teams. TL;DR questions below, details after.

Leah: 1) For ICs who are mid-cycle promo-eligible, what's the lead time from manager recommendation -> payroll/comp change? 2) Any changes to the weighting used in performance calibration for FY27? 3) Parental leave top-up question: are contractors eligible or is that still headcount-only? 4) If someone got a comp bump this quarter, does that affect promo timing?

Ava (People Ops): Great questions — thanks, Leah. Short answers up front: 1) Typical lead time: 2–6 weeks after manager approval (depends on comp committee queue & payroll cutoff). 2) Yes — we increased cross-functional impact weight (details below). 3) Contractors: currently not eligible for top-up; we can evaluate on legal/business case. 4) Q4 bumps don't automatically reset promo clock; promotions still follow eligibility rules (manager + calibration consensus). I'll paste links and a short timeline.

Miguel: For #1, is there a hard cutoff for an approval to make the next cycle? e.g. if manager files on Friday and comp committee meets Monday, is that fast enough?

Ava (People Ops): In practice, hitting the comp committee cutoff the week before payroll is ideal. If you miss that, it rolls to the next payroll. We try to batch approvals for efficiency. If it's urgent, DM me + your manager and we can request an ad-hoc review.

Samir: On #2 — increased cross-functional impact weight sounds good. What's the new split?

Ava (People Ops): New calibration weights for FY27 (summary): Technical excellence: 40% -> unchanged; Cross-functional impact: 15% -> 20%; Leadership & ownership: 25% -> 25% (unchanged); Growth & craft: 20% -> 15%. Full rubric and examples here: https://intranet.redwood/peopleops/fy27-calibration (recording + slides).

Rohit: Curious if managers will get an extra calibration workshop? Last time some teams skipped the training and results were inconsistent.

Ava (People Ops): Mandatory 60min calibration training for all managers — recorded session + live Q&A next Wed 11am PT. Managers who don't attend will be required to review the recorded content and submit a short acknowledgement form.

Leah: On parental leave top-up (Q3) — are there any grandfathering rules or exceptions for folks who transitioned from perm->contractor in the middle of leave?

Ava (People Ops): Good catch — current policy: top-up eligibility is tied to employment type at leave start. If someone transitioned mid-leave, we evaluate case-by-case. People Ops + Legal will handle exceptions; please route to me privately with specifics so we can track.

Miguel: One last one — comp bumps and promo timing: if someone got a market adjustment in Jan, can they still be considered for promo in Mar?

Ava (People Ops): Yes — market adjustments don't disqualify promo consideration. Managers should document rationale so calibration committee has context.

HR-bot: Reminder — promo nomination docs due by 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC. Submit here: https://intranet.redwood/forms/promo-nom.

Leah: Perfect, thanks Ava. Could you drop a short FAQ summary in the people-ops channel and tag managers? Would help avoid lots of DMs.

Ava (People Ops): Will do — posting FAQ & timeline in ~30min and adding the calibration recording + template. Ping me if you need one-off timelines for international payroll. :thumbsup:
